text: I am not in the UK right now so it's a bit tricky. I'm also of the understanding that it needs to be notarised (by a lawyer) and then apostilled. Lucikly, there are lots of UK private service providers who I post the documents too and then they notarise, apostille and send back to me. I also have to do this for the UK police check. It will cost me about 250 pounds - which is a lot. However, cheaper than a plane ride and quicker than doing it myself in the UK
